text: `slots ask <type> "<what>" [--lane <lane>]` writes `requests/<id>/ask.json` and prints the id; `grant <id> --lane <lane>`, `deny <id> "<why>"`, `revoke <id> "<why>"`, `start <id>` and `release <id>` each write their one file; a request's state is the fold of the files present (asked, granted, running, ended, denied, revoked); and a grant that would put the lane over its capacity, counting granted and running, is refused naming the count.
